summary: Okta claim prefix change causes missing identity_zone claim — blocks Secrets Portal access
description:
Issue summary:
Several internal users report receiving a 403 when attempting to open the Secrets Portal after a successful Okta SSO flow. Login completes at the IdP, but the internal console rejects the session due to missing RBAC claim.

Impact:
- Multiple engineers (oncall and platform) cannot access the Secrets Portal to retrieve runbook keys and short-term credentials.
- Work blocked for urgent incident response and a customer-facing rollout.
- Affects all users routed through Okta in us-east (estimated ~30 active users during incident window).

Observed behavior / Symptoms:
- Browser finishes Okta redirect and returns to /secrets-portal with 403 Forbidden page.
- Identity token (JWT) visible in flow lacks the expected identity_zone claim (previously present as rdw:identity_zone).
- Auth-proxy logs show repeated WARN: "missing identity_zone claim - RBAC lookup failed".

Environment:
- Prod - us-east cluster behind identity-proxy v2.3.1.
- Okta tenant: redwood-prod (attribute transform rules recently modified 2026-03-11).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Use a valid Redwood SSO account and initiate login to https://secrets.redwood.ai in us-east.
2) Complete Okta authentication (MFA).
3) Observe redirect back to portal and 403.
4) Inspect returned ID token embedded in session; identity_zone claim missing or renamed to zone.

Relevant logs / snippets:
- auth-proxy (us-east-01) 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z WARN auth: missing identity_zone claim - RBAC failed for sub: U12345
- auth-proxy 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z DEBUG token: claims=[iss, sub, email, name, zone]
- Okta system audit shows transform rule "strip-rdw-prefix" deployed 2026-03-11 22:08 UTC: https://okta.internal/admin/audit/ea/38921

Initial hypothesis:
- A recent Okta attribute transform removed the "rdw:" prefix from several SAML/OIDC claims. The Secrets Portal RBAC matcher expects identity_zone or rdw:identity_zone; without it, the RBAC lookup silently fails and returns 403.

Investigation notes:
investigation_notes: 10:30 - Confirmed reproduction on staging-proxy by toggling Okta transform and observing claim name change.
11:05 - Pulled token from failing user session; token contained 'zone' but not 'identity_zone' or 'rdw:identity_zone'.
11:30 - Checked Okta admin: found transform rule 'strip-rdw-prefix' merged via infra PR #4521 (author: j.kim).
12:00 - Reviewed auth-proxy claim mapping configuration: proxy expects 'identity_zone' key; no aliasing for 'zone'.
12:45 - Cross-checked RBAC service: lookup keys include 'identity_zone' and 'rdw:identity_zone' only; missing 'zone' alias.
13:10 - Reproduced fix by adding temporary mapping in auth-proxy config to treat 'zone' as 'identity_zone' and restarted proxy; users regained access.
13:40 - Notified Okta/Identity team and requested rollback of transform or explicit aliasing in Okta mapping rules.
14:00 - Identified associated internal runbook: CON-4499 (Secrets Portal RBAC mapping) for follow-up hardening.
14:30 - Capture: root cause appears to be a change in claim naming convention pushed without end-to-end contract verification with services relying on claim keys.
comments: Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-12 10:05: Raised ticket after first customer report in #support. Included token sample and 403 screenshot.
SRE (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-13 11:20: Confirmed logs and started reproducing in staging. Added temporary mapping workaround to auth-proxy config in us-east; rolling restart performed.

Identity (Jinsoo Kim) 2026-03-13 12:10: Okta transform 'strip-rdw-prefix' was intended to normalize claims for new apps. We will schedule rollback if required. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4521.
Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-13 12:45: Workaround validated by 6 affected users. Recommended mitigation: temporary mapping in auth-proxy and coordinated Okta rollback.
Security (Lena Ortiz) 2026-03-13 13:00: Please ensure any rollback keeps security invariants; avoid exposing legacy claim keys without a review.
SRE (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-14 09:15: Rolling back transform in Okta scheduled for 2026-03-14 11:00 UTC after window confirmation. Auth-proxy mapping retained as fallback.
Identity (Jinsoo Kim) 2026-03-14 11:05: Okta transform rolled back. Monitoring access and will confirm stabilization by 11:30 UTC.
resolution: Temporary: auth-proxy in us-east updated to alias incoming 'zone' claim to 'identity_zone' and service restarted (rollout at 2026-03-13 13:10 UTC). Permanent: Okta transform rule 'strip-rdw-prefix' rolled back (2026-03-14 11:05 UTC). Follow-up action items: add contract tests for claim key changes in infra CI, update CON-4499 runbook to include claim-change checklist, and implement a feature flag in auth-proxy to auto-alias known claim variants.
next_steps: 1) Add automated CI check on infra PRs that modify Okta transform rules to notify service owners (owner list in CON-4499).
2) Extend auth-proxy configuration to support claim aliasing via config map and ship config change with feature flag defaulted off until validated.
3) Security review of aliasing behavior to ensure no unintended privilege escalation from alternate claim names.
4) Post-incident retrospective scheduled: 2026-03-18 15:00 in #incidents; responsible: Jinsoo Kim, Marco Ruiz, Aisha Patel.
